Ingersoll-Rand India (INGR) reported strong execution in Q2FY27, with revenue growing 23.5% YoY to Rs4.0bn, while EBITDA margin contracted by 235bps YoY to 21.2%, likely due to input cost pressures which weighed on profitability.
The ongoing ramp-up of the Sanand facility is expected to support incremental volumes over the medium term, while enabling the introduction of new air-treatment and compression solutions.
